content.text: Since the etag is calculated from the last-modified property, this is probably impacted by fcrepo-1742.  I've added this case to the draft spec of what actions should update the last-modified property:
, I have found that the last-modified property does not appear to be properly updated under the conditions in which this issue was reproduced:

[...]
# Given two resources test/1 and test/2...
# Create an indirect container test/1/members
curl -v --data @create_indirect_container.ttl --header "Content-Type:text/turtle" -X PUT http://localhost:8080/fcrepo/rest/test/1/members

< HTTP/1.1 200 OK
* Server Apache-Coyote/1.1 is not blacklisted
< Server: Apache-Coyote/1.1
< Cache-Control: private
< Expires: Thu, 01 Jan 1970 00:00:00 UTC
< ETag: "123f5db42dc101b0a3c6a4fa0ffc234178f93027"
< Last-Modified: Tue, 17 Nov 2015 15:17:43 GMT

[...]
# Set test/1 as a proxy for test/2
curl -v --data @create_proxy.ttl --header "Content-Type:text/turtle" -X POST http://localhost:8080/fcrepo/rest/test/1/members
[...]

# Get the ETag for test/1 (now managed using an indirect container)
curl -v http://localhost:8080/fcrepo/rest/test/1

< HTTP/1.1 200 OK
* Server Apache-Coyote/1.1 is not blacklisted
< Server: Apache-Coyote/1.1
< Cache-Control: private
< Expires: Thu, 01 Jan 1970 00:00:00 UTC
< ETag: "123f5db42dc101b0a3c6a4fa0ffc234178f93027"
< Last-Modified: Tue, 17 Nov 2015 15:17:43 GMT
This issue may also be related to binary resource properties not refreshing in the web UI, FCREPO-1983.
I have what appears to be a properly working implementation of this. Because some tests rely on changes made to the 4.5.1-RC branch, I will hold off on a PR until after the 4.5.1 release.
Pending response to code review comments.
In testing for FCREPO-2213, I noticed something. When I created a child in an indirect container it updated the membershipResource, but did not update the eTag or Last-Modified date...
Here is a log of my actions
I think something must have undone this work.
When a triple is added to a resource's body because of indirect containment the etag doesn't change, despite the representation being different.
There was some discussion in IRC about the feasability of keeping the etag up to date.
